title: A Note Before We Begin
text: I know I'm not perfect, but nobody is. And, you know, that's okay. But that doesn't mean I shouldn't try to, you know, be something better.

title: From The Heart
text: I wanted to make this maybe sometime later, not now, but, you know what? Like, I do feel like I did hurt you, and even though you forgave me, I feel like I still have to make amends somehow, and right now I can't really make amends in the way that I want to.

title: Making Amends
text: I guess I'll try and make amends the way that I can for now, in a way that I feel like would mean a lot to you as well, and I hope this does.

title: Our Journey
text: That being said, I hope you really like this, and, you know, this is purely just for you, nobody else. And this is my thoughts and my memories to show, you know, for you. Like, for the journey we've had so far, basically. But yeah, I love you.
